faqs.question: Can this be used for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: We recommend doing a patch test before using the product.

faqs.question: Will it leave my skin sticky?
faqs.answer: No, this lightweight formula absorbs very quickly into the skin. This won't leave your skin sticky.

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be used twice a day.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months.

faqs.question: Can I Use Lactic Acid Body Lotion Daily?
faqs.answer: It is generally safe to use lactic acid body lotion daily, but starting with a lower concentration is important and gradually increasing the frequency of use. This helps to prevent any irritation or sensitivity. If you experience any redness or discomfort, it's best to discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

faqs.question: Does Lactic Acid Glow Skin?
faqs.answer: Yes, lactic acid can help to give the skin a healthy glow. By removing dead skin cells and stimulating cell turnover, it can help to reveal brighter, more radiant skin. However, using it as directed and not over-exfoliate is important, as this can lead to irritation and dryness.

faqs.question: What is the Use of 5% Lactic Acid Lotion?
faqs.answer: 5% Lactic Acid Lotion by Be Bodywise is an advanced formula that helps to improve skin texture and reduce the appearance of bumps on the skin. It also nourishes the skin with Cica Extract and Aloe Vera, which hydrates the skin and improves its elasticity.

faqs.question: What Are the Benefits of Lactic Acid in the Body?
faqs.answer: Lactic acid has several benefits for the body, including improving athletic performance, reducing muscle fatigue, and promoting weight loss. It also helps regulate the body's pH balance and supports healthy digestion.

faqs.question: What Are 3 Effects of Lactic Acid?
faqs.answer: Three effects of lactic acid are exfoliation, skin hydration, and improved skin texture. Exfoliation helps to remove dead skin cells and stimulate cell renewal, while skin hydration helps to moisturise and nourish the skin. Improved skin texture can help to reduce the appearance of bumps and other skin imperfections.
